segments.ja299:1.1: Pure tuvaṃ sīlavataṃ sakāse, okkantikaṃ [okkandikaṃ (sī. syā. pī.)] kīḷasi assamamhi;
segments.ja299:1.3: Karohare [karohi re (ka.)] makkaṭiyāni makkaṭa, na taṃ mayaṃ sīlavataṃ ramāma.
segments.ja299:2.1: Sutā hi mayhaṃ paramā visuddhi, komāraputtassa bahussutassa;
segments.ja299:2.3: Mā dāni maṃ maññi tuvaṃ yathā pure, jhānānuyutto viharāmi [jhānānuyuttā viharāma (sī. pī.)] āvuso.
segments.ja299:3.1: Sacepi selasmi vapeyya bījaṃ, devo ca vasse na hi taṃ virūḷhe [neva hi taṃ ruheyya (sī. pī.), na hi taṃ virūhe (?)];
segments.ja299:3.3: Sutā hi te sā paramā visuddhi, ārā tuvaṃ makkaṭa jhānabhūmiyāti.
